Any combination of fever, headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, or altered mental status should raise suspicion for meningitis and prompt immediate medical attention.
 
If you or your child has symptoms of bacterial meningitis, go to the nearest emergency room right away.
 
If your child is unwell with any of these symptoms, go to a hospital or call for an ambulance immediately.
 Additional red flags to watch for include 
a rash that does not fade when pressed with a glass
, and drowsiness or trouble waking, since 
later symptoms can include confusion, lethargy, or seizures.
